skills.name: download-anything
skills.description: Download supported files, videos and audio with Codex, using aria2, yt-dlp and FFmpeg where needed. Verify the saved file before calling the transfer complete.
requirements: yt-dlp for supported media pages; FFmpeg and ffprobe for media work
Authorized browser or connector capabilities for protected sources
skills.example_prompt: Use $download-anything to save this video at up to 1080p with audio into my Downloads folder.
